by
  intro f hf hm
  have hg : ContinuousOn (fun x => f x - x) (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := hf.sub continuousOn_id
  have h0 := (hm 0 (Set.left_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)).1
  have h1 := (hm 1 (Set.right_mem_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)).2
  obtain ⟨c, hc, e⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (zero_le_one' ℝ) hg (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (f 1 - 1) (f 0 - 0) from ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
  exact ⟨c, hc, by simpa [sub_eq_zero] using e⟩
